title: Spain: AEPD issued a temporary order halting Worldcoin biometric processing
description: On 6 March 2024 AEPD ordered Tools for Humanity Corporation to stop collection and processing of special-category personal data for Worldcoin in Spain and block data already collected. The urgent Article 66(1) GDPR measure had a maximum duration of three months.
confidenceBasis: Official published decision or announcement by the named data protection authority, retrieved during the 2026-10-08 research pass.
notes: Do not misstate this 2024 provisional measure as an indefinite or current nationwide ban; later EU lead-authority proceedings require independent status checks.

provenance.authority: Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (AEPD)

title: Portugal: CNPD temporarily restricted Orb biometric collection
description: On 25 March 2024 CNPD approved an urgent provisional measure restricting Worldcoin Foundation's collection of iris, eye, and face biometric data through the Orb in Portugal; it announced the decision on 26 March and cited particular concern for minors.
confidenceBasis: Official published decision or announcement by the named data protection authority, retrieved during the 2026-10-08 research pass.
notes: An interim measure pending investigation is not evidence of a permanent ban or of the platform's current operating status.

provenance.authority: Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (CNPD)

title: Hong Kong: PCPD found privacy-law contraventions and ordered iris scanning to cease
description: On 22 May 2024 PCPD concluded Worldcoin's Hong Kong operation contravened Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance Data Protection Principles on collection, retention, transparency and access/correction. The commissioner served Worldcoin Foundation an enforcement notice directing it to cease scanning and collecting iris and face images; Worldcoin confirmed 8,302 scanned participants.
confidenceBasis: Official published decision or announcement by the named data protection authority, retrieved during the 2026-10-08 research pass.
notes: The notice concerns the Orb biometric-collection operation in Hong Kong; do not claim it independently establishes a worldwide ban or later enforcement compliance.

provenance.authority: Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data (PCPD)

title: Portugal: CNPD identifies Bavaria as lead GDPR supervisory authority
description: On 10 July 2024 CNPD reported that documents showing Worldcoin Foundation had an establishment in Germany shifted the EU lead supervisory-authority role for its investigation to Bavaria's BayLDA; CNPD continued as a concerned supervisory authority.
confidenceBasis: Official published decision or announcement by the named data protection authority, retrieved during the 2026-10-08 research pass.
notes: A lead-authority jurisdiction change is not itself an exoneration, withdrawal, or new restriction.

provenance.authority: Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (CNPD)

title: Bavaria: BayLDA ordered Worldcoin biometric-data compliance corrections
description: On 19 December 2024 BayLDA announced corrective measures after reviewing Worldcoin's biometric processing: a GDPR-compliant erasure procedure after the order becomes final, express consent for specified future processing, and deletion of certain datasets previously collected without sufficient legal basis. The company had indicated it would litigate.
confidenceBasis: Official published decision or announcement by the named data protection authority, retrieved during the 2026-10-08 research pass.
notes: This is an administrative corrective order with finality and litigation conditions; do not assert that any appeal outcome, deletion implementation, or new 2026 enforcement status was verified here.

title: Brazil: ANPD suspended rewards for collecting iris biometrics
description: On 24 January 2025 ANPD imposed a preventive measure effective 25 January on Tools for Humanity, suspending cryptocurrency or any other financial compensation offered for iris collection in Brazil. The regulator separately directed the company to identify its personal-data protection officer on its website.
confidenceBasis: Official published decision or announcement by the named data protection authority, retrieved during the 2026-10-08 research pass.
notes: The order targets financial incentives for iris collection, not all Orb scanning, World ID authentication, or the World Chain network.

provenance.authority: Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados (ANPD)

title: Brazil: ANPD rejected appeal against iris-scan compensation suspension
description: On 11 February 2025 ANPD announced its board had rejected Tools for Humanity's administrative appeal and maintained the restriction on cryptocurrency or other payments connected to World IDs created through iris collection. The board refused an additional 45 days to implement compliance changes.
confidenceBasis: Official published decision or announcement by the named data protection authority, retrieved during the 2026-10-08 research pass.
notes: This confirms the payment-restriction decision on that date, not the complete current legal or operational status in October 2026.
